text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold B, C, and E in small chunks for gains; taking profits feels satisfying, but selling too early can leave too little invested if prices keep rising.","After selling repeatedly, I bought 100 shares of B and D again; I should avoid letting regret or recent price moves drive my decisions and use a clear plan for when to buy, hold, or sell.","My account value moved up and down even when I locked in gains, so I should assess results over time, manage concentration and risk, and not judge a trade by whether it feels good today."]}
